description: tooljet-agent builds, cost, tool calls, checkpoint pool and logs, from OTEL (ENABLE_OTEL=true).

panels.description: Builds that finished in the range, any outcome.
panels.title: Builds

panels.description: Share of finished builds whose outcome was success. Answered and paused count against it only if they happen.
panels.title: Success rate

panels.description: Builds in flight at the end of the range, across the selected pods.
panels.title: Running now

panels.description: 95th percentile wall time of a build. Buckets: 1, 5, 10, 30, 60, 120, 300, 600, 1200 s, so values are interpolated.
panels.title: p95 build time

panels.description: Estimated model cost of finished builds (the agent's own estimate, not the invoice).
panels.title: Model cost

panels.description: All token types: input, output, cache read, cache write.
panels.title: Tokens

panels.description: Finished builds per interval, stacked by how they ended. Answered = a question answered instead of a build; paused = waiting on the user.
panels.title: Builds by outcome

panels.description: Median and 95th percentile build wall time over a rolling hour. Gaps mean no builds finished in that hour.
panels.title: Build duration

panels.description: Which model provider ran each build.
panels.title: Builds by provider

panels.description: Builds in flight per pod. Rolling deploys drain these before a pod stops.
panels.title: Builds running

panels.description: Estimated cost per interval. Hybrid builds whose usage arrives after the build ends are under-counted (known issue).
panels.title: Model cost by model

panels.description: Tokens per interval. A high cache_read share means prompt caching is working.
panels.title: Tokens by type

panels.description: Total estimated cost divided by finished builds, over the selected range.
panels.title: Average cost per build

panels.description: Calls per tool over the range, any status.
panels.title: Most-called tools

panels.description: Share of calls per tool that returned an error or were refused. Cancelled calls are excluded.

targets.expr: sum by (gen_ai_tool_name) (increase(agent_tool_calls_total{service_name="tooljet-agent", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", service_instance_id=~"$instance", status="error"}[$__range])) / (sum by (gen_ai_tool_name) (increase(agent_tool_calls_total{service_name="tooljet-agent", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", service_instance_id=~"$instance", status=~"ok|error"}[$__range])) > 0)

panels.title: Tool error rate

panels.description: All MCP calls per interval. Error includes refusals, which return normally but carry an error.
panels.title: Tool calls by status

panels.description: Connections held (used) and free (idle), against the configured maximum, summed across pods. Used reaching max is what exhausts the pool.
panels.title: Connections

panels.description: Callers queued for a free connection right now. Anything above zero means the pool is exhausted.
panels.title: Builds waiting for a connection

panels.description: Should stay at zero. Lost connections point at a network problem between the agent and its database.
panels.title: Pool problems

panels.description: How long a request that had to queue waited, on average.
panels.title: Average wait for a connection

panels.description: Connection requests per second, and how many of them had to wait.
panels.title: Pool requests

panels.description: Agent log lines per interval. Warnings and errors are the ones worth reading.
panels.title: Log lines by level

panels.description: Filter with the search box above. Expand a line for its build context: tooljet_thread_id, tooljet_request_id, trace_id.
panels.title: Agent logs
Failed generations
panels.description: Agent turns that ended in error. Click a trace id to see every hop.

targets.query: { resource.service.name = "tooljet-agent" && name = "invoke_agent tooljet-app-builder" && status = error } | select(span.gen_ai.conversation.id, span.tooljet.ai.stop_reason, span.tooljet.ai.failure_category, span.error.type)

panels.title: Server errors caused by AI
panels.description: ToolJet server requests made on behalf of an AI generation that returned 4xx/5xx (validation rejections, missing apps, permission errors).

targets.query: { resource.service.name = "tooljet" && span.tooljet.origin = "ai" && (span.http.response.status_code >= 400 || span.http.status_code >= 400) } | select(span.http.route, span.http.response.status_code, span.http.status_code, span.gen_ai.conversation.id)

panels.title: AI-caused server request errors by route
